text:
Sam: Quick thread to finalize landing copy and lead routing for the upcoming launch. Focus: Hosted API, Dedicated, Private. Goal: lock hero lines, benchmark card bullets, webinar CTA text, and HubSpot routing by EOD.
Rina: I sketched 4 hero candidates for each page. Hosted candidates lean developer-first; Dedicated leans performance & predictability; Private is compliance-forward. Posting them in #marketing-briefs in 10.
Owen: can we avoid passive jargon like 'infrastructure for LLMs'? prefer active: 'Serve LLM features with predictable latency.'
Leah: Agree. For Hosted hero try: 'Production-grade LLM inference — ready out of the box.' Subline: 'Low latency, predictable costs, instant scale.'
Sam: Leah's direction feels good. Rina, include a short 1-line dev example under hero (single curl) so engineers immediately see how simple it is.
Rina: noted. For benchmark cards proposal: three bullets per deployment: p95 latency (ms), tokens per $1 (or $ per 1M tokens), and a sample throughput metric. e.g. Hosted: p95 200ms • $40 / 1M tokens • burst to 150 rps. Dedicated: p95 90ms • $25 / 1M tokens (committed) • 1200 rps steady. Private: p95 110ms • $20 / 1M tokens (on cert infra) • supports 1000 rps.
Owen: please don't print exact $, use ranges or placeholders until finance signs off. Use 'approx.' or 'from $'.
Leah: good call. I'll change to 'from $25 / 1M tokens' etc. Also include an accessibility microcopy: 'Results may vary based on model and prompt.'
Rhea: Webinar CTA idea: primary button 'Watch: Production Inference at Scale' with secondary 'Get the benchmark PDF'. Registration workflow: HubSpot collects company_size, role, region. Hidden field 'routing_tier' set by workflow (enterprise / mid-market / startup).
Sam: Routing rules: if company_size >=1000 OR role contains 'platform' and company_size >=200 -> tag enterprise. Rhea can you map these in HS?
Rhea: yes — I'll add a property 'redwood_tier' and workflow conditions: enterprise, midmarket, startup. Enterprise -> notify #sales-enterprise + create AE task. Midmarket -> send to SDR queue. Startup -> auto-enroll in trial email stream.
Owen: We should also gate the benchmark PDF download with an optional email + company field, same routing logic. That helps capture leads without forcing registration for webinar replay.
Rina: micro-CTAs near benchmark cards: 'Full benchmark' (modal), 'Compare deployments' (new page anchor), 'Claim a demo' (form). Make them button style and mobile-friendly.
Leah: On Private page copy: must call out 'KMS support, HSM readiness, audit logs, SOC2+#compliance badges'. Also a line: 'Deploy in your VPC or on-prem with a customer-controlled control plane.'
Sam: Who owns final copy? Rina — drafts for all three, Leah — tone polish, Rhea — forms & routing, Owen — QA on numbers. Deadline: submit final drafts in #marketing-briefs by 18:00 PT today.
Rhea: noted. I'll also add HubSpot field names to the brief: company_size, role, region, redwood_tier, marketing_source. Workflow screenshot will be attached.
marketing-bot: Reminder: content freeze scheduled 2024-05-09T01:00:00Z. Snapshot will be archived.
Leah: small social idea tied to webinar: 3 short clips (30-60s) based on each panel (latency, cost, rollout). We'll use benchmark highlights as pull quotes.
Owen: quick legal flag — don't say 'guaranteed' latency. Use 'target p95' or 'typical p95'. I'll ping legal for one-line approval.
Sam: thanks. last bit: add testimonial slots under each page: Hosted (early-stage AI app), Dedicated (scale SaaS), Private (banking/regulatory). Rina pls add placeholder quotes.
Rina: will do. Posting drafts in 10 and tagging reviewers.
